question_en: List the change summaries of CRs approved at meeting RAN3#123 (meeting-outcome review).
cypher: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WHERE m.meetingNumberInt = 123 WITH a MATCH (a)-[:REFERENCES]->(c:CR) WHERE c.reasonForChange IS NOT NULL RETURN c.tdocNumber, c.summaryOfChange ORDER BY c.tdocNumber DESC LIMIT 10
